title: ROS Concept Matcher
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Robot Software (ROS 2)
description: Read six ROS 2 and robot-description terms beside a picture of two nodes joined by one topic. Then match eight short descriptions to the terms Node, Topic, Message, Publisher, Subscriber and URDF. Used in Chapter 13.

educational.topic: ROS 2 vocabulary: node, topic, message, publisher, subscriber, and URDF
learningObjectives: Identify the ROS 2 or robot-description term that matches each of eight short descriptions, with at least 7 of 8 correct on the first attempt

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Read each term beside a labelled picture, then recognize the term from a description
keyQuestions: What is the difference between a node and a topic?
Why does a publisher not need to know who its subscribers are?
commonMisconceptions: A publisher sends to a particular subscriber
assessmentOpportunities: Eight committed matches, one attempt each; 7 of 8 for mastery
